Remark
[Infinite asymptotic scalar curvature ratio] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0076 ↗ thm:chow-iii-dimension-reduction-two 1. ch18:18.20\group Dimension Reduction

The hypotheses of Theorem 2 imply $\operatorname {ASCR}(g(0))=\infty $, and its curvature bounds are comparable to the curvature at the centers, ensuring that the limit is nonflat.
